availability_policy: Unavailable previous observation, zero denominator norm, or undefined cosine are kept in quartile -1 and excluded from cuts/support.

prespecified_analysis_contract.adaptive_support: Additionally an observed-feature stratum has attenuation benefit and another has harm in >=2/3 Validation seeds using Train quartile cuts; no target-defined gate
prespecified_analysis_contract.aggregation: three seed mean and sample SD; paired seed and event differences
prespecified_analysis_contract.features: observed quantities and encoded/retrieval telemetry only; no future target features
prespecified_analysis_contract.fixed_attenuation_support: At least one alpha<1 lowers dataset mean Validation RMSE by >=1% and improves >=2/3 seeds; all six metrics and all datasets retained
prespecified_analysis_contract.inferential_limit: Post-Test exploratory diagnostic; inference intervention is not newly trained model performance
prespecified_analysis_contract.stop: No fixed support: do not launch gate training. Fixed support alone: report constant attenuation evidence, do not claim adaptive need.
prespecified_analysis_contract.strata: Train feature quartiles, frozen before inspecting Validation attenuation outcomes

support.interpretation: Exploratory diagnostic support only; no trained gate effect, causal attribution, or independent Test evidence.
